rule: A risk entry is not permission for a migration-day rewrite. M0 preserves behavior; fixes are sequenced behind evidence and rollback.

risks.finding: Passport and canonical Progression coexist as overlapping authorities.
risks.impact: XP/badges/discoveries/unlocks can diverge or be reinterpreted.
risks.post_m0_action: make canonical Progression sole writer; retain compatibility reader until proven safe

risks.finding: Legacy Passport XP is copied numerically into a different 10-level economy.
risks.impact: Same XP can imply a different level/title/unlock set.
risks.pre_m0_action: preserve both stores and document semantics
risks.post_m0_action: migrate earned unlocks/status explicitly, not XP alone

risks.finding: Canonical Canyon origin is duplicated across runtime/source/generated surfaces.
risks.impact: Partial rename can break updater, SEO, RSS or schema identity while UI still appears healthy.
risks.post_m0_action: one source-owned site metadata authority + regenerate

risks.impact: Package identity becomes durable once stable signing/public distribution begins.
risks.post_m0_action: dedicated Kona.m appId/signing decision before stable native release

risks.impact: Large blast radius and poor regression attribution.
risks.post_m0_action: extract room construction, movement, interaction and lifecycle one seam at a time

risks.finding: Older engineering viewer is ~52 kB / ~835 lines and owns rendering plus multiple product-experience subsystems.
risks.impact: Second monolith; tempting but risky to merge with Kona world runtime.
risks.post_m0_action: decide reusable product-viewer engine vs Canyon-specific exhibit

risks.finding: User Studio combines stage lifecycle, avatar editor, drawers, sharing, races, feed/travel and settings.
risks.post_m0_action: split controller/view seams while retaining one route/state authority

risks.finding: ~108 !important declarations in a 16.4 kB mobile compatibility layer.
risks.impact: High cascade complexity and expensive visual reasoning.
risks.post_m0_action: reduce by ownership zones with physical-phone visual evidence

risks.finding: Shared and feature selectors can overlap across a large cascade.
risks.impact: Path-dependent styling leaks or subtle device-specific overrides.
risks.post_m0_action: one owner per shared selector; feature CSS only owns feature geometry

risks.finding: Embedded collectible renderer has DPR cap and disposal but no explicit hidden-tab guard.
Several page-lifetime render loops lack explicit hidden-tab pause; experience engine requests high-performance.
risks.post_m0_action: add shared lifecycle policy and verify no visual/timing regressions

risks.finding: Known hall entrance can draw millions of triangles / high draw-call counts because repeated full bike clones remain in legacy architecture.
risks.post_m0_action: room-graph culling/shared geometry/LOD with physical-device budgets

risks.finding: Current CSP still requires script-src unsafe-inline and wasm-unsafe-eval.
risks.impact: Broader script execution surface than ideal.
risks.post_m0_action: inventory inline execution; move/hash/nonce what can be removed without breaking WebAssembly/legacy pages

risks.finding: Source changes deterministically regenerate multiple committed bundles.
risks.impact: A source-only patch can appear correct but is invalid until generated outputs match.
risks.pre_m0_action: treat generated drift as hard failure
risks.post_m0_action: keep owner/build metadata and consider release artifacts only where architecture permits

risks.finding: Workflows currently use mixed explicit Node majors (notably 20 and 22).
risks.impact: Different parsing/runtime behavior and future support drift.
risks.pre_m0_action: do not combine CI runtime change with M0
risks.post_m0_action: converge on one supported Node major or document exceptions

risks.finding: Binary estate has not yet had one exact-hash deduplication and large-file inventory gate.
risks.impact: Migration can carry duplicate bytes and unnecessary repository weight.
risks.post_m0_action: dedupe only exact duplicates after path/cache/build impact review

risks.finding: Several UI modules duplicate the same HTML escaping helper while a canonical helper already exists.
risks.pre_m0_action: document; do not source-refactor without regenerated bundles
risks.post_m0_action: centralize with exact generated-output and visual evidence

risks.finding: Canonical progression has current streak but not historical best; GameState reports best as current streak when engine state exists.
risks.impact: Historical best streak semantics can be lost.
risks.post_m0_action: add best_streak to canonical schema before Passport retirement
